Name: Furniture Recolours (Alternative Textures)
Author: siamece
Description:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/mISwXFR.png[/img]

This mod adds black, white, birch, walnut, oak, mahogany, and rainbow colour options to most furniture, excluding paintings, plants, rugs, and wall decor.
The black matches the colour scheme of the 'dark' furniture set, while the white matches the 'winter' furniture set. 


This is a pack for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url] and will not work without it. Buy the Paint Bucket from Robin and click on placed furniture to change it's texture.


The full list of edited furniture/colour options is under the spoiler below:
[spoiler]
[b]red armchair:[/b] white, red, pink, orange
[b]red couch:[/b]      white, red, pink, orange
[b]blue armchair:[/b] black, teal, purple
[b]blue couch:[/b]      black, teal, purple
[b]large brown couch:[/b] black, white, red, pink, orange, yellow, green, teal, blue, purple
[b]pink plush seat:[/b]   white, red, pink, orange
[b]green plush seat:[/b] black, teal, blue, purple
[b]red diner chair:[/b]     white, red, orange, yellow
[b]blue diner chair:[/b]   black, green, teal, purple
[b]dining chair:[/b] black, white, birch/orange, walnut/blue, oak/green, mahogany/red
[b]box lamp:[/b] black, white
[b]ornate/classic/country lamp:[/b] black, white, birch/orange, walnut/blue, mahogany/red
[b]double/child bed:[/b] black, white, birch/orange, walnut/blue, mahogany/red
[b]oak furniture set: [/b] black, white
[b]modern furniture set:[/b] black, white
[b]mahogany furniture set:[/b] black, white, birch, walnut, oak
[b]pub/sun/moon/luxury table:[/b]   black, white, birch, walnut, oak
[b]butterfly hutch/china cabinet:[/b] black, white, birch, walnut, mahogany
[b]diviner/grandmother's/festive dining table:[/b] black, white, pink, orange, yellow, green, teal, blue, purple
[b]large bear/rabbit/bear/junimo/small junimo plush:[/b] black, white, red, pink, orange, yellow, green, teal, blue, purple
[b]plasma/floor tv:[/b] black
[b]budget tv:[/b] black, black/black, black/white, black/birch, black/walnut, black/mahogany
[b]tree of the winter star:[/b] black, black/gold, black/blue, white, white/gold, white/blue, orange, orange/gold, orange/blue

[/spoiler]
[u]                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       [/u]


Future Plans:
- black/white versions of every painting, different wood colours for frames
- black/white/orange/teal options for plants
- separate pastel & dark packs for every piece of furniture

feel free to suggest other things you'd like to see!
